blurb: Guests join certified guides on family-friendly kayak tours exploring mangrove tunnels, lagoons, and wildlife habitats. Tours include day and night options, with opportunities to see dolphins, manatees, birds, and bioluminescence. Locations include Cocoa Beach Thousand Islands, Turkey Creek Sanctuary, Honest John's Fish Camp, and Ramp Road Park.
